title: RDF Knowledge Graph Indexing
description: Configuration for RDF knowledge graph indexing.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: List of entities that you need to reindex. Leave empty to index all supported entities.

recreateIndex.title: Recreate RDF Store
recreateIndex.description: Clear the RDF store before indexing.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Maximum number of entities processed in a batch.

producerThreads.title: Producer Threads
producerThreads.description: Number of producer threads to use for non-distributed RDF indexing.

consumerThreads.title: Consumer Threads
consumerThreads.description: Number of consumer threads to use for non-distributed RDF indexing.

queueSize.title: Queue Size
queueSize.description: Internal queue size for non-distributed RDF indexing.

useDistributedIndexing.title: Use Distributed Indexing
useDistributedIndexing.description: Enable distributed RDF indexing with partition coordination and recovery.

partitionSize.title: Partition Size
partitionSize.description: Number of entities per partition for distributed RDF indexing.

blueGreenRebuild.title: Blue/Green Rebuild
blueGreenRebuild.description: Build the rebuild into an idle dataset and switch to it only after the run succeeds, so queries keep seeing the previous graph instead of a partially-rebuilt one. Requires roughly twice the dataset size on disk. Only applies when Recreate RDF Store is enabled.

minSuccessRatio.title: Minimum Success Ratio
minSuccessRatio.description: Fraction of records that must index successfully before a blue/green rebuild is allowed to become the served dataset. Below this the previous dataset keeps serving and the run is marked failed.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of failed write attempts tolerated per relationship source before that source is abandoned for the run.
